chainIntro: The notice names six instruments as its legal basis, in the order below, and cites them wholesale rather than by article. Each one is held in the corpus as its own text. Open any of them to read it beside the notice.

The 2013 notice at the foot of the list is not cited by the 2026 one. It is its structural predecessor: the same ministry, the same licence, the same three levers of testing, disclosure and filing, applied to pre-installed apps rather than to pre-installed agents.
